summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload on the installer's host
details: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui-cypress 9.0.5 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs on every `npm install`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (_0xNNNN identifiers) and, if a local `bun` is not present, downloads the Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip, extracts and chmods the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` via execFileSync. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line Bun-CJS blob using string-array rotation (function `WV8StW` rotates a large `n7gIxM` literal table) and a custom-charset decoder — a payload that Node-based scanners cannot observe because it is only executed under Bun. The package is presented as Cypress helpers, a purpose that has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque install-time payload. The alternate-runtime-dropper transport plus heavy obfuscation of both loader and payload deliver install-time code execution on the installer's machine on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
